title: Friendship Flag Exchange #4
summary: PPs Rtns Jankhana and Darshan Mehta Visited the Rotary Club of Pune Royal.
description:
PPs Rtns Jankhana and Darshan Mehta
Visited the Rotary Club of Pune Royal.
In her words "we were very warmly welcomed by their Office Bearers and we enjoyed meaningful conversations on service, fellowship, and future collaborations. It was inspiring to learn about their 12-year journey and the impactful work of their 25 dedicated members across Rotary’s Areas of Focus. I loved the flag designed by Rtn Puja Parikh this year.
More than just a Club Flag, it is a postcard from our Club and hence symbolizes friendship and serves as a cherished keepsake exchanged with Rotary clubs across the world.
Visits like these reinforce the true spirit of Rotary: building friendships, exchanging ideas, and creating greater impact together".
